label: Повесть
description: A 10-sentence usage card for повесть (tale; novella).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Повесть' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative. 'Грустная' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'очень' intensifies it. A simple descriptive model.

missions.phrase: Я прочитал эту повесть за вечер.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Повесть' is the accusative direct object of 'прочитал'; for this feminine soft-sign noun the accusative matches the nominative. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Повести' is the genitive modifying 'сюжет', the plot of what. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive. Common in literary discussion.

missions.phrase: В этой повести нет счастливого конца.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Повести' is prepositional after 'в', the work within which something is found. 'Нет' then takes the genitive 'конца'. A useful literary pattern.

missions.phrase: Учитель рассказал нам о повести Гоголя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Повести' is prepositional after 'о', the topic of the lesson. 'Гоголя' is the genitive of authorship. Good for classroom Russian.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Повести' is the dative governed by 'посвятил', the thing time was devoted to. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative. Note the soft-sign declension.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with verb. 'Повестью' is instrumental after 'восхищаюсь', which governs the instrumental. 'Короткой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A literary-praise phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Повестей' is the genitive plural after 'много', expressing quantity. 'Интересных' agrees in the genitive plural. Note the soft-sign plural ending.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Повести' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' is the agreeing demonstrative and 'одним автором' is an instrumental of agent. A literary observation.

missions.phrase: Мы обсуждали героев в двух повестях.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Повестях' is the prepositional plural after 'в', and 'двух' agrees in the same case. 'Героев' is the animate accusative object. Useful for comparison.
